name: Blazar Polygon plugin
description: Polygon-first DeFi tools for agents: BZB swaps via BlazarFeeRouter, any-token swaps via KyberSwap/LI.FI/Velora with token-safety checks, wallet portfolio, tx status, gas and approvals audit on Polygon, Base and Ethereum, plus Polygon staking, trading rewards, earning strategies and contract templates. Read-only tools and UNSIGNED transactions; no keys. Discovery card: the agent is reached over MCP (Streamable HTTP) and REST, not A2A messaging.

extensions.description: MCP server (Streamable HTTP, no auth): https://api.blazarforce.net/mcp

skills.name: Quote and build BZB swaps
skills.description: Best route across BlazarSwap, QuickSwap V2 and Sushi V2; unsigned fee-router tx that earns trading rewards

skills.name: Swap any token on Polygon, Base or Ethereum
skills.description: KyberSwap and LI.FI compared (same-chain only), Velora fallback: token-safety check, router allowlist, exact approve, simulation; unsigned txs plus an EIP-5792 batch. Polygon by default; chain base or ethereum
examples: Swap 25 USDC to WETH on Polygon
Quote 100 USDC to WETH on Base

skills.name: Token safety check
skills.description: Verified lists, honeypot / fee-on-transfer flags, proxy check, simulated transfer and sell

skills.name: Wallet portfolio, tx status, gas, approvals
skills.description: Balances with USD (LP and staking positions on Polygon); receipts with decoded logs and revert reasons; gas costs; allowance audit and unsigned revokes. Polygon, Base and Ethereum

skills.name: Stake BZB
skills.description: Staking info and unsigned stake/withdraw/claim txs

skills.name: Earning strategies
skills.description: Live onchain staking, LP and reward data

skills.name: Contract templates
skills.description: Unsigned deploy txs for ERC-20 and staking-pool templates

skills.name: Venue comparison
skills.description: Fee-router route vs each venue vs an aggregator, with rewards eligibility

skills.name: Trading-rewards preview
skills.description: Leaderboard estimate from live logs with the documented rules

skills.name: Bot helpers
skills.description: Limit check, TWAP plan (dry run), event polling
